spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Niamh Varga. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and I’m really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating. I can see a payment for £186.40 to Northstar Travel on 22 October, and your current balance is £742.18. Is that the one you mean?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s it. I’ve never used Northstar Travel.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why that would concern you. Before I look at the payment any further, can I take your full date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s 14 March 1988, and 26 Alder Road, Leeds.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. I’m not able to complete the identity checks from those details, so I can’t make any changes to the account or discuss further account information.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s disappointing. I’ve already had to call twice, and I still don’t know what’s happening with the payment.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had to contact us more than once, Niamh. I’ll log this as a complaint about the handling of the unrecognised card payment and your experience contacting us.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The complaint will be reviewed, including the concerns you’ve raised about the payment and your previous calls. You’ll receive a full written response within 15 business days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will you be able to tell me whether the payment is going to be refunded?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t promise an outcome. The written response will explain what we found and any decision made; I can’t discuss the account further today because the identity checks weren’t completed.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. So it’s logged as a complaint, and I’ll get a full written response within 15 business days, but you can’t say whether I’ll get the money back.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. To summarise, the complaint is about the unrecognised Northstar Travel payment and your previous contact with us, and a full written response will be sent within 15 business days. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for your patience, Niamh. Is there anything else I can help with today?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks for calling Thistle Bank. Goodbye.
